title: Litmus 22: World’s Biggest Atheist Meet in India
description:
Litmus is back — and it’s bigger than ever. Litmus 22, held in Kochi, Kerala, was the world’s largest atheist meet, with thousands of free-thinkers, rationalists, and humanists coming together under one roof. This video is your curtain raiser to what unfolded at this historic event.

From powerful talks on science, law, medicine, and social issues, to hard-hitting debates on atheism vs religion, Litmus 22 showcased the best voices of reason. The theme this year — “God is Harry Potter” — captured the spirit of rationalism: God, like Harry Potter, is just another character in a book.

Speakers included ex-believers like Askar Ali, outspoken critics of pseudoscience like Dr Cyriac Abby Philips (The Liver Doc), sharp rationalists like Krishna Prasad, Baiju Raju, and Manuja Mythri, as well as powerful panels featuring Pranav Radhakrishnan (Science is Dope), Chandrasekhar Ramesh (Lucy Malayalam), and many more. With 18 presentations and thousands of attendees, Litmus 22 was a celebration of free thought.

Highlights included:

Panel discussion “God – The Missing Link”, debunking creationist myths about evolution.
Talks on consanguineous marriages, caste-borne diseases, pseudoscience in medicine, and communist genocides.
Award ceremony honoring young freethinkers and humanists.
Debate “War of Words” on religious education, moderated by Arif Hussain Theruvoth.
Closing talk “God is Harry Potter” by Ravichandran C, a stalwart of rationalist thought.

If you’ve searched for atheist meet in India, Litmus atheist event, esSENSE Global, Javed Akhtar atheist speech, God is Harry Potter event, atheist movement Kerala, or India’s biggest rationalist gathering, this video gives you the inside look.

Like, comment, share, and hype this video so more people learn about the power of evidence-based thinking and the growing humanist movement in India.
